auth.signInSubtitle: Enter your account details to continue
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
auth.staffOnlyNotice: This page is for store staff. Customers never need an account.

register.title: Register a store
register.subtitle: Fill in your store details. A platform supervisor reviews the request and emails you the decision.
register.acceptTerms: I agree to the terms of service
register.acceptDataProcessing: I agree to the data processing agreement, and I am responsible for obtaining each customer's consent to use their data
register.mustAccept: You must agree in order to continue.
register.verifySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
register.doneBody: Your request is now with a platform supervisor. Once approved you will be emailed, and you sign in with the email and password you just chose.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.subtitle: Choose a password for this account:
setPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.invalidBody: This invitation link has expired or was already used. Ask your store owner or platform support to send a new one.

admin.merchantsSubtitle: Review requests, activate accounts, and keep track of subscriptions.
admin.searchMerchants: Search by name, register or email
admin.notVerified: Cannot be activated until the owner has confirmed their email address.
admin.decisionHint: Rejection and suspension both require a reason, and every decision is written to the audit log.
admin.noActions: No action applies to the current account status.
admin.activateBody: "{{merchant}}" will be activated, and its owner can sign in with the password they chose when registering.
admin.activated: The store account is now active.
admin.restoreBody: "{{merchant}}" returns to active, and its staff can sign in again.
admin.rejectBody: The request from "{{merchant}}" will be declined. The applicant receives the reason and may correct the details and apply again.
admin.suspendBody: Staff of "{{merchant}}" will be locked out. No customer data or balances are deleted.
admin.suspended: The store account has been suspended.
admin.reasonPlaceholder: Write a clear reason; it is kept in the audit log
admin.reasonHint: Required, and shown to the store owner.
admin.retentionNotice: Customer data and balances are retained until at least {{date}} before any archiving or deletion.
admin.subscriptionHint: The plan sets the caps on branches, users and monthly invoices.
admin.planUpdated: The subscription plan has been updated.
admin.currentCaps: Current caps: {{branches}} branches, {{users}} users, {{invoices}} invoices per month.
admin.ownerPending: The account is active but the owner has not set a password yet, so they cannot sign in.
admin.ownerReady: The owner has set a password and can sign in.
admin.resendInvitationBody: A new link will be emailed to {{merchant}}. The previous link stops working immediately.
admin.resendInvitationHint: The link goes straight to the owner mailbox and is never shown here.
admin.invitationSent: A new invitation has been emailed to the store owner.

dashboard.posHint: Record a sale and register a customer at the counter.
dashboard.lookupHint: Look a customer up by phone number and see where they stand.
dashboard.queueWaiting: {{count}} registrations are waiting for a decision
dashboard.queueHint: Each one is somebody waiting for an answer.
dashboard.queueEmptyHint: Nothing is waiting on you right now.

validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.phone: Please enter a valid mobile number.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to open this page.

forgotPassword.title: Recover your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a verification code.
forgotPassword.codeHint: Enter the code and choose your new password. The code expires in {{minutes}} minutes.

branches.title: Branches
branches.subtitle: Add your store branches and their details. A branch is switched off, never deleted.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.atCap: You have reached your plan limit. Contact platform support to upgrade.
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add your first one to get started.
branches.disabled: The branch has been switched off.
branches.noDeleteNote: Branches are switched off rather than deleted, so the invoices recorded there keep their origin.

staff.title: Users
staff.subtitle: Create accounts for your staff and set each one's role and branch.
staff.name: Name
staff.emailHint: Used to sign in, and receives the invitation to set a password.
staff.emailLocked: The email cannot be changed after the account is created.
staff.branchHint: Branch managers and reps only see their own branch.
staff.invitationNote: No password here — the user receives an invitation and chooses their own.
staff.invitationPendingHint: This user has not set a password yet, so they cannot sign in.
staff.atCap: You have reached your plan limit. Contact platform support to upgrade.
staff.needBranchFirst: Staff cannot be added before an active branch exists, since managers and reps are tied to one.
staff.added: The user has been added and invited.
staff.invitationSent: A new invitation has been sent.
staff.noDeleteNote: Users are disabled rather than deleted, so the invoices they entered stay attached to them.

loyaltyRule.title: Loyalty rule
loyaltyRule.subtitle: You decide when a customer earns a reward and how much it is. Any change publishes a new version and leaves existing balances untouched.
loyaltyRule.noneYet: No rule published yet. The values shown are suggestions; adjust them and publish to begin.
loyaltyRule.thresholdHint: The bar a customer has to reach to earn the reward.
loyaltyRule.bothHint: The customer must meet both conditions, not either one — this option tightens the bar rather than widening it.
loyaltyRule.rewardHint: The shape of the reward and its value.
loyaltyRule.voucherHint: The customer receives a voucher of a set value to spend on a later visit, with an expiry date.
loyaltyRule.maxDiscountHint: Protects your margin on large cycles.
loyaltyRule.voucherValidityHint: Leave empty for a voucher that never expires.
loyaltyRule.minInvoiceHint: An invoice below this is recorded but does not count — it stops a sale being split to manufacture visits.
loyaltyRule.scopeHint: Pooled is usually right: the customer deals with your brand, not with one branch.
loyaltyRule.carryOver: Carry the surplus into the next cycle
loyaltyRule.resetHint: Carrying over is fairer: a customer who reached 1,160 against a 1,000 threshold does not lose the extra 160.
loyaltyRule.balanceValidityHint: A customer balance expires if they do not buy within this period. Leave empty for no expiry.
loyaltyRule.exampleTitle: What does this mean in practice?
loyaltyRule.exampleHint: A worked example using your current settings.
loyaltyRule.exampleCapNote: The cap reduced the reward — that is deliberate, to protect your margin on large cycles.
loyaltyRule.publishFirstHint: The rule applies to sales from the start date onwards.
loyaltyRule.publishReplaceHint: A new version will start on the chosen date. The current one is kept and continues to govern invoices recorded before then. A past date cannot be chosen.
loyaltyRule.historyHint: Every version is kept with its period, because recorded invoices are governed by the version that was in force at the time.
loyaltyRule.author: Published by

pos.title: Record a sale
pos.subtitle: Ask the customer for their mobile number, then enter the invoice.
pos.phoneHint: Ask the customer for their number and search for it.
pos.consent: The customer agrees to receive messages
pos.consentHint: Ask them out loud. They may withdraw it at any time.
pos.noRule: No loyalty rule is published, so nothing accumulates. The sale is still recorded.
pos.anonymousNotice: The customer declined to give a number. The sale will be recorded without a customer and accumulates nothing.
pos.belowMinimum: Below the minimum — it will be recorded but will not count.
pos.eligibleTitle: This customer has earned a reward
pos.eligibleBody: Tell them now. Paying it out needs a branch manager or the owner.
pos.enterInvoiceNumber: Enter the number from the receipt
pos.invoiceNumberHint: Leave empty and the system numbers the sale.
pos.pendingCorrections: {{count}} correction requests are waiting for your decision

lookup.title: Customer lookup
lookup.subtitle: Enter a mobile number to see the customer position and purchase history.
lookup.eligibleNow: This customer is eligible for a reward now.
lookup.notFound: No customer is registered with this number.
lookup.noExportNote: This screen is read-only. Exporting or printing customer lists is not available.

redeem.title: Pay the reward
redeem.capped: Calculated at {{computed}} {{currency}} and capped by the rule ceiling.
redeem.carriedNote: {{amount}} {{currency}} has been carried into the new cycle.
redeem.notEligible: This customer has not reached the threshold yet.
redeem.notEligibleHint: Not eligible yet — an exception needs the owner.
redeem.ownerOnlyOverride: Only the store owner can authorise an exception.
redeem.overrideReasonHint: Kept in the audit log with your name.
redeem.overrideReasonRequired: Write the reason, at least five characters.

correction.title: Cancel or return an invoice

types.cancel: Cancel the invoice — it was entered by mistake
types.partial_return: Partial return — part of it came back

correction.returnedAmountHint: Less than the invoice; returning all of it is a full return.
correction.returnedAmountRange: Enter an amount above zero and below the invoice.
correction.reasonHint: Explain what happened — the manager decides on this, and it stays on the record.
correction.reasonRequired: Write the reason, at least ten characters.
correction.needsApproval: The request goes to the branch manager. Nothing changes until they decide.
correction.appliesAtOnce: You can approve corrections, so this takes effect immediately.
correction.queueSubtitle: Cancellations and returns waiting for your decision.
correction.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
correction.approved: The request has been approved and the balance corrected.
correction.rejected: The request has been rejected and nothing has changed.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Sales, rewards, branches and staff over a period you choose.
reports.branchLocked: These figures cover your branch. Only the store owner sees every branch.
reports.correctionsHint: Requests raised, including refused ones. An unusual number is worth a look before it becomes a pattern.
reports.noRewards: No rewards were paid in this period.
reports.overrides: {{count}} rewards were paid as an exception, worth {{amount}} in total.
reports.vouchersOutstandingHint: Issued, unspent and still valid — credit you owe today.
reports.exportHint: A CSV covering the period above, ready to open in Excel.
reports.exportConsented: Only those who agreed to be contacted
reports.exportAuditNote: Exports are recorded in the audit log with your name, the time and the number of records.

adjust.title: Correct the balance
adjust.reasonHint: Say what happened and why. This is the entry an auditor stops at.
adjust.auditNote: Recorded in the audit log under your name, with the reason and the amount.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.subtitle: Your name, logo, city and currency — what your customers see.
settings.logoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It is resized on upload.
settings.detailsHint: The trade name, where you are, and the currency amounts are shown in.
settings.registeredNameFixed: Verified at registration; contact platform support to change it.
settings.tradeNameHint: The name customers know you by, if it differs from the registered one.
settings.storeSaved: The store details have been saved.
settings.logoSaved: The store logo has been updated.

erase.title: Erase the customer at their request
erase.removed: The name and phone number are removed and cannot be recovered.
erase.kept: The invoices, the ledger and the rewards stay as they are, for the accounts.
erase.balanceLost: The balance of {{amount}} {{currency}} is closed and cannot be claimed.
erase.vouchersLost: Unspent vouchers are withdrawn. Vouchers already used stay used.
erase.reasonHint: What the customer asked for. Kept in the audit log without their details.
erase.reasonRequired: Write what the customer asked for, at least ten characters.
erase.acknowledge: I understand this cannot be undone.
erase.acknowledgeRequired: Confirm that you understand before continuing.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Who did what, and when. Entries are never edited or removed.
audit.byAction: What the activity is made of

profile.title: My account
profile.subtitle: Your picture, your details and your password.
profile.pictureHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It is resized on upload.
profile.emailFixed: The email identifies your account and cannot be changed here.
profile.passwordHint: Changing it signs your other devices out. This one stays signed in.

alerts.title: Things worth a look
alerts.subtitle: Patterns the system noticed in the chosen period.
alerts.disclaimer: These are observations, not accusations. Every pattern here has an innocent explanation — read the evidence and judge for yourself.
alerts.emptyBody: No unusual pattern was found in this period. This is the normal result.
alerts.summary: {{total}} observations, {{high}} of them worth looking at first.

out_of_hours.title: Sales entered outside opening hours
out_of_hours.hint: A late stocktake explains this. So does an invoice with no customer standing there.

frequent_corrections.title: Entries that keep being undone
frequent_corrections.hint: Ask what keeps going wrong. A rep cancelling their own entries is how a false one disappears.

backdated.title: Sales entered long after they happened
backdated.body: {{count}} entries keyed in, the latest {{days}} days after the sale date.
backdated.hint: A busy till explains a day or two. A week fits a sale into a cycle that was already measured.

repeated_redemptions.title: The same customer collecting reward after reward
repeated_redemptions.overrides: {{count}} of them were exceptions authorised by hand.
repeated_redemptions.hint: A genuinely loyal customer looks like this. So does a card being farmed.

rep_customer_concentration.title: One employee and one customer
rep_customer_concentration.body: {{user}} registered this customer and entered {{count}} of their purchases ({{share}}%).
rep_customer_concentration.hint: A regular has a favourite cashier. A fabricated customer has only one.
